**Risk flags:**  
- Single shareholder holds 57.42%

**Overview:**  
Delima Pacific Academy Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited company providing professional training courses in accounting and finance. It is incorporated on 5 June 1991 and operates from Kuala Lumpur. The firm has a share capital of 250,000 and two directors, with the largest shareholder owning 57.42% of the equity. Reported revenues are 25,095,450; 26,622,433; and 27,546,638 across three recent periods, while equity stands at 6,791,054; 8,209,568; and 9,515,594 respectively. No legal cases are recorded, and audit opinions or profitability metrics are not provided.
